text: {"rules":[],"notes":"D014 describes Boston's Housing Stability Notification Act (effective 2020-11-06). The ordinance requires landlords to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with a notice to quit or non-renewal, and to send a copy of that notice to the Office of Housing Stability. It carries fines for violations. It does not limit evictions to listed causes, require just cause, or provide relocation assistance. Its notices are not tied to any such limits, so it falls outside just_cause_eviction. The document says nothing about rent increase limits, security deposits, application or screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. No in-scope rule was extracted."}
